attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb_storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), regenerated the initramfs so the block applies pre-boot, and verified the module cannot be loaded now. Performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id/btime, rebooted node1 with the native reboot mechanism, polled until SSH/exec returned, confirmed a new boot_id/btime proving an actual restart, and re-verified post-restart that usb_storage is still unloaded and modprobe still refuses to load it.
